sources.description: Standalone full painted rectangle. Chest-up mature man with the head and gaze turned slightly screen-left, screen-right ear visible, and a calm closed mouth. Tan fedora with a broad dark reddish-brown band and a wide brim; preserve its shape, tilt and cast shadow. Short dark side hair is visible beside the ear, dark brows, round dark-rimmed spectacles over both eyes, curled dark moustache with grey at the ends, and a full short salt-and-pepper beard covering cheeks/jaw/chin. Brown civilian suit jacket with broad notched lapels, cream pointed shirt collar and a diagonal reddish-brown/beige striped tie; no visible medals. Preserve the outfit, closed shirt/tie arrangement, shoulder and bust crop, upper-left warm face/hat light, darker screen-right side and short neck contact inside the collar. Grey-beige painted background fills the whole rectangle; no card, frame, note or exterior transparent silhouette. Exact156x210 original, nearest4x full enlargement, nearest8x face crop and unchanged user mascot reference actually viewed. Actual source alpha254..255 is visually solid and does not authorize cutting out the backing. Evidence limit: individual beard/hair strands, fine spectacle hardware and fabric microtexture are below exact-source resolution; no claim of microscopic matching. visible-alpha-v1 and visible-source-differences-v1.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Chest-up man in a slight three-quarter screen-left view, looking near forward/screen-left, with a neutral closed mouth and smooth upper lip, cheeks and chin without a distinct moustache or beard. Short combed side-parted dark hair with prominent grey streaks and grey temples; retain the swept waves, dark brows and visible screen-right ear. A single round monocle covers the screen-right eye, with its thin chain curving down the screen-right cheek toward the jaw; the other eye has no second lens. No hat. Medium cool-grey civilian suit with broad notched lapels, off-white pointed shirt collar and plain dark navy tie. Preserve the closed shirt/tie arrangement, compact neck/collar contact, shoulders and bust crop, upper-left facial highlights and darker screen-right shading. Muted grey-brown painted background fills the entire rectangle, with no frame, card or paper note. Exact156x210 original, nearest4x full enlargement, nearest8x face crop and unchanged user mascot reference actually viewed. Actual source alpha254..255 is visually solid; preserve the backing rather than creating an exterior cutout. Evidence limit: the thin monocle-chain links, individual hair strands and fine fabric texture cannot be resolved microscopically, while the single-lens structure and chain path are visibly established. visible-alpha-v1 and visible-source-differences-v1.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Chest-up man with a slight screen-left head turn, near-forward gaze and a subtly raised mouth corner. Olive-brown fedora with wide brim and a darker brown band; short close dark hair remains visible at the sides beneath it. Strong dark brows and a thin dark moustache are visible; no eyewear. Preserve the distinct narrow dark scar-like line above the screen-right brow and the curved dark line extending from the outer screen-right eye down that cheek. Olive-brown windowpane/check jacket with broad pale beige turned collar, over a grey shirt fastened at the neck by a small pale button; no necktie or medals. Preserve the original lapel/collar layers, short neck contact, shoulders and chest crop, upper-left facial/hat light and dark screen-right shading. Grey-beige painted background fills the complete rectangle, without card/frame/note or exterior transparency. Exact156x210 original, nearest4x full enlargement, nearest8x face crop and unchanged user mascot reference actually viewed. Actual source alpha255..255. Evidence limit: a tiny dark mark immediately below the lower lip cannot reliably distinguish a short hair tuft from lip/chin shadow at this resolution; preserve the visible mark without asserting a separate goatee or adding a broader beard. Individual hair strands, scar microtexture and exact plaid-weave texture are likewise not resolved. visible-alpha-v1 and visible-source-differences-v1.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Chest-up man in a three-quarter screen-right view, with screen-left ear visible and eyes glancing near forward/screen-right, a serious closed mouth, dark brows and a smooth upper lip and chin with no distinct moustache or beard. Tan/light-grey fedora with dark reddish-brown band, wide brim tilted downward toward screen-right; preserve the hat tilt and its forehead shadow. Short close dark wavy hair with grey temple streaks is visible beneath the brim at screen-left. No glasses. Light beige trench/overcoat with high raised rear collar, wide notched front lapels and small stitched buttonhole details on both lapels, over an off-white shirt and dark burgundy tie; a small dark inner layer shows beneath the tie. Preserve the original collar/lapel layering around the short neck, closed shirt/tie, shoulders and bust crop, upper-left facial highlights and darker screen-right cheek. Muted grey-brown painted background occupies the complete rectangle; no card, frame, note or silhouette cutout. Exact156x210 original, nearest4x full enlargement, nearest8x face crop and unchanged user mascot reference actually viewed. Actual source alpha243..255 remains visually solid, not an instruction to remove the original backing. Evidence limit: fine hair strands, lapel-stitch construction and tiny tie pattern cannot be resolved microscopically; the visible outfit, hat, clean face and pose are established. visible-alpha-v1 and visible-source-differences-v1.
